dialogues.speaker: Perasa
dialogues.text: A vacation... Yeah right. This is clearly some sort of exile!

dialogues.speaker: Durov
dialogues.text: Now, now, dear... Th—This is just a temporary stop along the way! The actual vacation comes right after this, I promise...

dialogues.speaker: Perasa
dialogues.text: Liar! Before we came here, you said, "Nod-Krai has islands, just like Petrichor. It'll be just like Petrichor." That was a lie as well!

dialogues.speaker: Durov
dialogues.text: N—No, why would I lie to you? Look, look, this is what "The Teyvat Travel Guide" has to say—

dialogues.speaker: Perasa
dialogues.text: "The Teyvat Travel Guide" doesn't say anything about Nod-Krai! You must have been reading "Teyvat Travel On A Shoestring"!

dialogues.speaker: Perasa
dialogues.text: Ugh... Mielikki and Vesnia went on a hot spring holiday to Natlan for their vacation. They fed Koholasaurs. This place... There's nothing here! Y—You don't even love me!

dialogues.speaker: Durov
dialogues.text: Please don't say that! M—Maybe this place isn't as p—pretty as Natlan, and there aren't any c—cute little saurians and h—hot springs... B—But, as long as we're together, everywhere is a vacation, r—right?

dialogues.speaker: Perasa
dialogues.text: If everywhere is a vacation, then why not just vacation on PETRICHOR!?

dialogues.speaker: Durov
dialogues.text: D—Do you want to go to P—Petrichor? Alright, but we'll need to visit the Northland Bank first...

dialogues.speaker: Perasa
dialogues.text: Petrichor is good. Natlan is good. Literally anywhere that isn't here is good!
